hypothesis: S1.10a: the autumn reframe of S1.10 (Bipartisanship Has a Season). H1: the share of D+R press-release statements containing at least one frozen bipartisan phrase is lower in autumn (Aug 6-Nov 3) than in the preceding summer (May 8-Aug 5), lower than in the preceding spring (Feb 7-May 7), and lower than the mean of summer and the following winter (Nov 5-Feb 2), each by more than 0.01, in at least ceil(0.9 n) valid years.

unit_and_metric.phrase_rule: Case-insensitive substring match on statement text (title excluded), as wave_s1.s1_10_bipartisan_season. Must equal pipeline.search.wave_s1._BIPARTISAN at the registration commit; the script refuses otherwise.
unit_and_metric.population: member party D or R; independents and unknown party excluded
unit_and_metric.rate: statements with >=1 phrase / all D+R statements, per season per lane (share, 0..1)

statistics.W: Q4 - Q3, reported only (committed contrast, strict-lane recount)

unit_and_metric.delta_rationale: DELTA is below every committed autumn-to-winter difference, so it constrains T only in new years. For the blind criteria it is about one standard error in the thinnest seasons; the 11-of-12 rule, not any single year, carries the inference.
unit_and_metric.year_supports_H1: D_summer > 0.01 AND D_spring > 0.01 AND T > 0.01, pooled D+R
unit_and_metric.decision_scope: pooled D+R; D and R computed identically and always reported, never decisive
unit_and_metric.blindness_note: D_summer and D_spring are blind (Q1, Q2 unmeasured). T is half committed (T = D_summer/2 + W/2). T cannot bind in C1: every committed W exceeds 0.01, so T passes whenever D_summer does. It does real work only in C2/C3, as the guard against a falling within-year ramp (Q1 > Q2 > Q3 > Q4), which passes both blind criteria while T is about 0.
unit_and_metric.reported_only: per-criterion and per-party counts; W under strict lanes; folded-scraped robustness; binomial tails; every season's rate and n; each of D_summer, D_spring, T, W in standard-error units (binomial SE of the difference, sqrt(p1(1-p1)/n1 + p2(1-p2)/n2); for T the Q2-Q4 mean carries a quarter of the sum of their variances)

lanes.legacy: season wholly within 2013-01-03..2020-12-31; count date_source == legacy only
lanes.scraper: season wholly on or after 2021-01-04; count date_source == scraper only
lanes.invalid: any season spanning the 2021-01-03 seam or reaching before 2013-01-03
lanes.robustness_view: post-seam years recounted on folded scraped (scraper + page_html); reported, never decisive
lanes.disclosure_2021: Scraper coverage was still growing through 2021 (docs/13 L411-416), so 2021's season differences mix roster change with calendar. The year stays in; no rule change.

floors.note: A year is valid only if all four seasons clear 200 pooled D+R statements and each lies in one lane.

C1.rule: n = valid years; need = ceil(0.9*n); k = years supporting H1. UNDERPOWERED if n < 8; CONFIRMED if k >= need; REFUTED otherwise. Per-criterion counts reported.

C2.earliest_run: 2027-02-16, and only with the mirror refreshed through at least 2027-02-02
C2.rule: PASS if all four seasons clear the floor and 2026 supports H1; UNDERPOWERED if any season is below the floor; FAIL otherwise.

C3.rule: as C2; follow-up, not a publication gate; a FAIL after publication adds a correction to the essay.

publication_rule: P5 may publish the autumn headline only if C1 is CONFIRMED and C2 is PASS. Otherwise S1.10 stays on the graveyard and methods shelf (docs/27 section 6, Artifacts row). C2 UNDERPOWERED holds publication; no substitute year.
script: scripts/search/s1_10a_autumn.py, revision 2 (staged at X:/onscript-data/drafts/staged/P5/scripts/). Tested on synthetic fixtures only (test_s1_10a_fixture.py): drift (5 seeds), ramp with January reset (3 seeds), winter rebound with no autumn trough (3 seeds; W passes every year yet the verdict is REFUTED), summer trough, sub-DELTA dip, flat, falling within-year ramp, and an autumn dip present in only 10 of 12 years are never CONFIRMED; the falling ramp is a single-year FAIL; an autumn dip with and without drift, and one present in exactly 11 of 12 years, is CONFIRMED; thin corpus UNDERPOWERED; lane hygiene. Refuses to run without --confirmatory, refuses if this file is untracked or modified, refuses C2/C3 before their dates, and stamps this file's sha256 into its output.
amend_policy: FROZEN at commit. No edits to unit_and_metric, lanes, floors, tests or publication_rule after the hash. A design change is a new registration with a new date; the old one stays in the record with its result.
